meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Now: free app + Founding Partner waitlist. At M2: the paid Basic plan with 20% off for FP; later, full list price.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Free now. 20% FP at M2. Then list price.
hero.body: Use the app for free. If you want 20% off the Basic plan when we ship M2, join the Founding Partner waitlist. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. We announce list amounts at paid launch.

callout.title: New here?
callout.body: Founding Partner means a free waitlist sign-up now and 20% off the Basic plan when we open payment with M2 — with no obligation. Anyone who comes later pays list price.

fpYearly: Founding Partner: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment
cancel: No contract — cancel anytime (once subscriptions exist)

free.name: Free plan
free.for: To use Mobilcab on your own projects until we open paid plans.

basic.name: Basic plan
basic.for: At paid launch with M2: design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and quotes. FP waitlist: 20% off; later: list price.

more.title: More detail
more.body: How Free differs from Basic, what’s included at M2, and how Founding Partner works — on the FAQ page.

note: We don't charge subscriptions until the paid Basic plan opens with M2. List prices are announced then. The FP discount (20%) is only for people on the Founding Partner waitlist.
